# Version 3.119.2
> **Platform packaging hardening** · Released February 6, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.3/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.2 improves native package hardening and restores missing platform-specific surface and symbol support. The release adds missing tvOS creation overloads, preserves Android symbols, and strengthens Windows native binaries.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## API Surface

- **tvOS SKSurface creation overloads restored** — tvOS consumers regain the SKSurface.Create overloads needed to create compatible rendering surfaces. — ❤️ [@MartinZikmund](https://github.com/MartinZikmund) ([#3342](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3342))

## Platform

- **Android symbols are packaged** — Android native symbols are preserved in the package output to improve diagnosis of native crashes. ([#3374](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3374))
- **Windows native binaries are hardened** — Windows builds enable Control Flow Guard and buffer-security checks, while Linux and Windows native builds gain Spectre mitigations. — ❤️ [@Aguilex](https://github.com/Aguilex) ([#3397](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3397), [#3404](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3404), [#3496](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3496), [#3502](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3502), [#3497](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3497), [#3503](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3503))
